question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>4</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>DNP</mi></math> test can be used to identify :

solution.text:
2, 4-DNP test is useful for the identification of carbonyl compounds.

The 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine can be used as a process for the identification of aldehydes and ketones.

The formed 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone is a solid that is purified and the melting point is determined. The comparison of a melting point with a table of known values could identify the compound as aldehyde or ketone
